title: Prepaid Dental HMO Plans Emergency Care Amounts and Out-of-Area Reimbursement Limits
content:
## Prepaid Dental HMO Plans: emergency amounts by plan

Four plan amounts govern emergency dental care under the Cascade DentalCare DHMO plans: the copay for palliative emergency treatment at the assigned primary care dentist, and, for an emergency treated by a non-network dentist, the most reimbursed per incident, the minimum distance from the assigned dentist and the period for submitting the receipt.

| Plan | Palliative emergency copay at the assigned primary care dentist (USD) | Most reimbursed per out-of-area emergency incident (USD) | Minimum distance from the assigned dentist (miles; must be exceeded) | Receipt submission period (calendar days after the emergency) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 50 | 180 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | 20.00 | 75.00 | 50 | 180 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | 15.00 | 75.00 | 50 | 180 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | 10.00 | 100.00 | 50 | 180 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | 5.00 | 100.00 | 50 | 180 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | 0.00 | 150.00 | 50 | 180 |

### Definitions

- **Palliative emergency copay**: USD per palliative emergency treatment at the assigned primary care dentist.
- **Out-of-area reimbursement maximum**: USD most reimbursed per out-of-area emergency incident.
- **Minimum distance**: miles; an out-of-network emergency is reimbursed only if it occurred more than this distance from the assigned primary care dentist.
- **Claim period**: calendar days after the emergency within which the member must submit the receipt.

### Notes on the figures

- The minimum distance is 50 miles on every plan and must be exceeded: an emergency exactly 50 miles from the assigned primary care dentist is not more than 50 miles; one 51 miles away is.
- The receipt period is 180 calendar days after the emergency on every plan.
- The reimbursement maximum is a per-incident ceiling: 50.00 on the DHMO 215, 75.00 on the DHMO 315 and 415, 100.00 on the DHMO 515 and 615, and 150.00 on the DHMO 715.
